domain-information: As a moderator, I want to create an estimation session and invite team members, so we can start estimating together.
As a moderator, I want to add work items to our estimation backlog, so we have a clear list of what needs to be estimated.
As a moderator, I want to edit estimation items during the session, so I can clarify requirements based on team discussion.
As a moderator, I want to select which item we're currently estimating so the team knows what to focus on.
As a moderator, I want to reveal estimates before everyone has voted, so we can proceed when most opinions are known.
As a moderator, I want to record the final agreed estimate for each item, so we can track our decisions.
As a moderator, I want to re-estimate items we've already discussed, so we can adjust based on new insights.
As a moderator, I want to import items from our existing task lists, so I don't have to manually retype everything.
As a moderator, I want to review past estimation sessions, so I can reference previous decisions.
As a moderator, I want to export our estimation results, so I can share them with stakeholders.
As a team member, I want to join an estimation session easily, so I can participate in planning.
As a team member, I want to see all items we're estimating today, so I understand the full scope of work.
As a team member, I want to see the current item clearly, so I know exactly what I'm estimating.
As a team member, I want to select my estimate privately so my opinion isn't influenced by others.
As a team member, I want to see who has voted and who hasn't, so we know when we're ready to discuss.
As a team member, I want to see all estimates revealed simultaneously so voting remains unbiased.
As a team member, I want to change my estimate during voting, so I can adjust based on team discussion.
As a team member, I want to see estimation history for the current item, so I understand how opinions have evolved.
As a team member, I want to know who gave each estimate, so we can have productive discussions about differences.
As a team member, I want to use a timer during discussions, so we stay focused and efficient.
As a team member, I want to review past estimates in the session, so I can maintain consistency.
As a team member, I want the estimation scale to remain consistent, so I can compare estimates easily.
As a user, I want the application to work reliably and quickly so our estimation sessions flow smoothly.
As a user, I want clear error messages when problems occur, so I know how to proceed.
As a researcher, I want to analyze estimation patterns anonymously, so I can study team decision-making processes.

domain objects.name: Team
domain objects.desc: Group of people estimating work together.

domain objects.name: Moderator
domain objects.desc: Person who leads estimation sessions and records results.

domain objects.name: Team Member
domain objects.desc: Person who joins estimation sessions and gives estimates.

domain objects.name: Estimation Session
domain objects.desc: Meeting where the team estimates work items.

domain objects.name: Round
domain objects.desc: One estimation cycle for an item.

domain objects.name: Estimation Backlog
domain objects.desc: List of items to be estimated.

domain objects.name: Session Log Data
domain objects.desc: Collected data of all votes, estimates, and results.

domain objects.name: Estimation History
domain objects.desc: Record of past votes and discussions for an item.

domain objects.name: Estimate Vote
domain objects.desc: Individual estimate from a team member.

domain objects.name: Estimation Scale
domain objects.desc: the scale or metric on which the Item will be rated

domain objects.name: Task List
domain objects.desc: External source of items added to the backlog.

domain objects.name: Voting Reveal
domain objects.desc: Moment when all votes are shown to the team.

associations.desc: Estimate Votes appear in Voting Reveal.
Estimation History adds to Session Log Data.
Agreed Estimate stored in Session Log Data.
